_comment: protos-all round (2026-11-13): a stored prototype for every EXE function Ghidra had none for (signature source DEFAULT, purge 0), dumped from the project after the round. Source: main's src/GRIMFANDANGO.EXE/functions.h (the decompiler's own inference, which the validated build compiled against), __cdecl. Scalar undefinedN made concrete (uint, ushort, byte, ulonglong) so Ghidra cannot re-type them; pointer types kept, except for functions with a hand-written override (fully concrete, return locked: the declaration must match the override). A void return of a generated function stays `undefined` so callers keep inferring their use of EAX. Fixed by hand: qsort / bsearch (void *), Lua_Stub (char *fmt, ...), fle_zfilio_config (int cmd, ...). Left DEFAULT: VbrAdpcm_Uncompress (reuses a pointer parameter's slot as a table index), x87 returns, functions without RET, the 6 whose view was not cdecl. Replay after names/sweep_protos.json: tools/apply_logic_protos.py names/protos_all_exe.json
